name: R-Breaker current research checkpoint: historical fees + ATR20/1% risk + fee-safe lock routing

config.margin_policy: strategy decision-time caps; no forced deleveraging; pending opens reserved; closes release after fill
config.allocation: simultaneous entrants share free margin equally, each capped at 50%; entry quantity fixed; no holding pyramids
config.reversal: close completely, then size new opposite entry at following callback
config.margin_assumption: constant 15% research assumption, not verified historical schedule
config.clock_assumption: 09:30 discrete opening auction; 09:31-15:00 continuous end labels
config.execution_routing: all closes including unlocks require zero same-contract same-side today fee balance; otherwise opposite open; eligible locked inventory first
config.funding_basis: net exposure 50%, actual physical larger-side margin 90%; pending closes release nothing; execution guard for this trial only
config.inventory_cleanup: obsolete-main inventory exits submitted before next auction; current-main locks retained for future signals
config.strategy_cost_estimate: unchanged .000023 for sizing and estimated exit costs; actual fills use historical FeeService
config.auction_policy: pre-existing instructions fill at auction price without slippage; post-result signals next continuous open with slippage

stop.trigger: completed minute high/low touches ATR or trade loss budget; next allowed open
stop.accounting: FIFO original entries and actual fees, no reset on daily settlement

formulas.daily_return: equity_t/equity_previous_trading_day-1; first day uses initial cash
formulas.calmar: calendar CAGR / maximum drawdown from daily settled equity, including initial cash
formulas.minute_calmar: calendar CAGR / stored maximum minute drawdown
formulas.product: shared-pool attribution, includes all actual contracts; no separate product capital
